description: A formal process for reporting security incidents has not been established. This signal indicates the absence of documented procedures for internal and external incident reporting as required by CMMC practices.
applicability: Organizations handling Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), Defense contractors pursuing CMMC certification, Systems requiring incident response capabilities

metadata.detection_notes: Detection involves reviewing incident reporting procedures, checking for defined reporting channels, and verifying that escalation paths are documented.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
